name: @agent-comms/adapter-t3
description: T3 adapter: delivers into T3 v0.0.44 threads through T3's own client runtime, matches replies from T3's records.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && if [ -d src/t3/node_modules ]; then tsc -p tsconfig.t3.json; else echo "adapter-t3: T3 not linked; skipped src/t3"; fi
